_README: SINGLE SOURCE for the eval-metric registry (names + order + direction + per-plot membership). Read by src/*.py via src/utils/metric_names.py (import) and by scripts/*.sh via its CLI (python src/utils/metric_names.py name <key>). NOTHING about metrics is hard-coded in the plot/eval code — every figure derives its rows from THIS file, so the forest, scorecard and scale plots always share one wording/order (the 2026-07-08 'Teacher-free gap' forest label vs scorecard 'free-running exposure-bias gap' divergence is impossible now). Key order below == the scorecard panel order. Per metric: name = the human label used in EVERY tick/title/prose line; dir = better-direction (higher|lower|signed); group = head/probe|predictor|encoder-temporal; forest = shown as a forest-plot row (true) or not (false: tax + order are the 2 of 15 the forest omits); plain = one-line layman gloss. Short keys (act, fut, teacher_free, ...) live in CSV/JSON/code ONLY.

act.name: Action top-1 accuracy
act.plain: classify the motion class from frozen features

tax.name: taxonomy F1
tax.plain: linear read-off of VLM scene attributes

mcos.name: motion-cosine separation
mcos.plain: same-motion clips sit closer than different-motion

fut.name: future-frame MSE
fut.plain: JEPA predictor's L1 on the masked next frame

rollout.name: rollout drift slope
rollout.plain: how fast multi-step prediction error snowballs

causal.name: causal future-block L1
causal.plain: predict the 2nd half of a clip from the 1st

tdist.name: L1-vs-Δt decay slope
tdist.plain: accuracy decay as it predicts further ahead

maskratio.name: mask-ratio robustness slope
maskratio.plain: graceful degradation as more video is hidden

order.name: frame-order sensitivity
order.plain: shuffled-ordered ΔL1 (does it actually use time?)

teacher_free.name: free-running exposure-bias gap
teacher_free.plain: worse on its OWN predictions vs fed the truth

tov.name: temporal-order (frame-permutation) acc
tov.plain: put shuffled frames back in order

tcc_cycle.name: TCC cycle-back error
tcc_cycle.plain: frame -> its match -> back: how far it lands off

tcc_tau.name: TCC Kendall τ
tcc_tau.plain: matching moments line up across two clips
